title: You Have Two Brains, Not One - Nautilus
gist: A team of neuroscientists from California argues that the brain is two distinct organs, one governing primitive functions such as breathing and heartbeat and one handling higher cognition. Lewis Thomas had hinted at this idea in 1979.
